metaDescription: Check the format of an ISPM 15 mark: two-letter country code, producer number, the hyphen between them, treatment code, and optional DUN.
heading: ISPM 15 stamp decoder
summary: A server-side form that checks the shape of a treatment mark, including the hyphen between the country code and the producer number, and explains each field.
intro: Enter the codes printed inside the stamp border. This page checks the format only. It does not look up a licensed facility, and it does not state an AGL price or a measured AGL result.
exampleNote: The sample mark written in the heat-treatment guide is a format example. It is not a real facility number and not an AGL measurement.

photo.label: Stamp photograph placeholder
photo.body: No photograph is shown here. AGL has not supplied a photo of a real treatment stamp. This slot is empty on purpose. It is not a stock image and not a stand-in.
photo.caption: Real stamp photos stay off this page until AGL sources them.

form.label: ISPM 15 stamp format check
form.dunLabel: This mark includes DUN (the wood is dunnage)
form.idle: Nothing is checked until you submit the form.

errors.countryShape: Enter the two-letter country code on its own.
errors.countryHyphen: Take the hyphen out of the country code.
errors.producerShape: Use letters and digits only in the producer number, up to 16 characters, with no spaces.
errors.producerHyphen: Take the hyphen out of the producer number.
errors.treatment: Choose a treatment code from the heat-treatment guide.

result.heading: Format check
result.ok: These fields fit the mark format described in the heat-treatment guide.
result.bad: These fields do not fit that format yet.
result.notLookup: This is a format check only. It does not confirm that a facility exists, and it is not measured AGL data.
result.schematicLabel: Text reading of the fields you entered. Not a photograph.
result.symbolNote: A real stamp also shows the IPPC symbol, a wheat-ear logo, on the left. This page does not draw that logo.
result.dunOn: DUN is included. Use it when the marked wood is dunnage rather than a pallet, crate, or box. DUN is not a treatment code.
result.dunOff: DUN is not included. Add it only when the marked wood is dunnage rather than a pallet, crate, or box.
